statuses.verified: read from shipped client code that X serves today, or measured on every relevant captured payload
statuses.derived: measured on a sample of public payloads; the rule is a statistic, not a guarantee
statuses.prior: industry knowledge or the plan's prior; no evidence from this snapshot. Needs the behavior lab

length.evidence: twitter-text config v3 (open source); URL weight 23 confirmed by note_tweet payloads whose full_text replaces each URL with a 23-unit t.co link. For the compact payload shape (what the logged-out pages embed), display_text_range and entity indices are code points, not UTF-16; see SPEC.md 'Ranges'.

longPost.evidence: 55 posts carry note_tweet; 52 are truncated bodies (visible body 258-281 code points, median 277, p25 273, p75 279). 44 of 52 (84.6%) match 'first 280 code points, back off to the last whitespace, trim end' exactly; 3 of the 8 misses are same-length URL-normalization differences, so 44/49 comparable bodies (89.8%) match. The other 5 differ by 4-9 code points, so the exact server constant or boundary preference is not recovered. Reproduce with node tools/rules/derive.mjs. See SPEC.md 'The long-post cut'.
longPost.unverifiedReason: Exact cut algorithm (280 vs 281, whitespace class, grapheme vs code point) needs the behavior lab: post long text at the boundary and re-read full_text/note_tweet.

serverBody.unit: code points of the authored text
serverBody.evidence: Captured timeline cells: display_text_range[1] is already X's cut (271, 277, 279, 280, 281 across the corpus) and full_text[..range[1]] is exactly the body the page renders, followed by the media/card t.co. The e2e harness compares against that text; rules uses it when present and only falls back to the derived 280-code-point cut for a draft.
serverBody.unverifiedReason: The derived cut still cannot reproduce X's exact server constant for a draft: 84.6% exact, 89.8% on comparable bodies.

longPost.detectBy: note_tweet.is_expandable === true; a short note (is_expandable false) is shown whole with no Show more (3 in the corpus: paulg 2119414341980012850, akirathedon 2118585012677157365, jack 1833951636005552366).

showMoreElision.unit: UTF-16 code units of the displayed body and of the note text (JavaScript string length)
showMoreElision.evidence: 1037d89b, chunk BsiDb726.js (sha256 e46395f6d8bf…): function f expands a cut note when n >= 200 and e.length - n <= 140 (h=200, g=140), where n is the displayed plain text length and e the note text, both JavaScript string lengths (UTF-16). DIdg36-I.js (89824c04) has no gate. The live 55591fe0 bundle (chunk D8W400Me.js, sha256 eee4f108554301e1…) still contains the gate but the live timeline does not apply it: captured post 2120188488628977819 (55591fe0) is shown cut at display_text_range [0,259] with a 'Show more' button, although the note is 356 code points (97 hidden, which 1037d89b would expand). The gate is therefore an allow-list: only 1037d89b expands; unknown/newer versions and drafts show the cut.
showMoreElision.unverifiedReason: Why 55591fe0 stopped applying the gate is not visible in its code (the function is still shipped). A logged-in home-timeline capture of 2120188488628977819 would settle whether the cell uses a different expansion state.

clamp.evidence: Server-rendered markup: main tweet text carries no line-clamp class (profile-vercel.html, probe.html); a quoted tweet's text carries line-clamp-5 (profile-vercel.html inline). Client constants WT=5 for tweet content and eT=2 for the nested quote. Clamp class map line-clamp-1..5 in CbDtO_Fz.js.

clampOverflow.test: scrollHeight > offsetHeight + 1, or for one line scrollWidth > offsetWidth + 1
clampOverflow.evidence: CbDtO_Fz.js Mpe(): (r.scrollHeight>r.offsetHeight+1||n===1&&r.scrollWidth>r.offsetWidth+1)!==a && o()?.(). DBT-6Eh8.js we(): jsxs(Fragment,{children:[` `,button]}); Te(): className `self-start` below the text for the clamped variant; button label t(`Show more`).

displayUrl.evidence: 85/87 entities match 'host minus www + (pathname+search) cut at 15 UTF-16 units + ellipsis' on captured display_url values. The two exceptions: youtu.be/vDjW_dRyKXY?si… (query kept when it fits the same 15-unit budget) and ▲.to (IDN shown in Unicode). Client grapheme truncator jz(e,t) in CbDtO_Fz.js. A captured compact payload's URL entity carries display_url (e.g. bbc.in/4foQRxp) while the text carries t.co/vAuRqIz67b; the page prints the display_url, so Post::links[url].display wins over the computed form (rules::url_display).

hiddenRanges.evidence: Client attachment-range algorithm in _D0BurxE.js: W(text,urls,mediaRange) walks trailing URL/media entities across whitespace from the end; Oe() matches a URL to card.legacy.url, quoted tweet id or article id and returns null otherwise, which stops the walk (je(): if(e===null)return i). Rendering hides only ranges whose attachment is rendered (ck(): t.card?a:null etc. in CbDtO_Fz.js). Range unit: in the compact shape display_text_range[1]=83 lands between the UTF-16 halves of an emoji and a code-point slice reproduces the page's text exactly (e2e: ESPN 2120010545872949671, F1 2119898824810389849); the client slices Array.from(text). Rules maps any incoming UTF-16 boundary that bisects a surrogate up to the next code point.
hiddenRanges.corpus: All 122 posts with a hidden trailing range hide exactly one ' https://t.co/XXXXXXXXXX' (24 code points) and every one of them has media; no captured payload hides a card URL (the card URL is hidden client-side, not via display_text_range).
hiddenRanges.payloadRangeUnits: code points for the compact profile/timeline payload; UTF-16 for the API (legacy) shape

trailingWhitespace.trimBeforeHiddenUrl: spaces, newlines and other Unicode whitespace
trailingWhitespace.evidence: 137 captured posts hide a trailing t.co via display_text_range; in 137 of 137 the range ends after the whitespace that precedes the URL (0 keep it), i.e. X hides that whitespace with the URL. Reproduce with tmp rules statistics over assets/vendor/corpus (SPEC.md §3). For a payload the converter already slices by that range; a draft has to apply the rule itself, otherwise the card or media leaves a blank line before it (e.g. a body ending '… “Show more”.\n\nhttps://vercel.com/blog/the-thing').
trailingWhitespace.draftRule: When a trailing URL is hidden by an attachment, the hidden range starts at the first whitespace character before it.

mediaClaimsTcoOnly.evidence: Every one of the 122 hidden trailing ranges in the corpus is a bare ' https://t.co/XXXXXXXXXX' appended for media, and no media post keeps a visible t.co at the end. A URL with any other host on a media post stays visible: media outranks a card, so nothing claims it (SPEC.md §6, media_beats_a_link_card).
mediaClaimsTcoOnly.unverifiedReason: A draft that pastes a t.co link and attaches media: X may instead fetch a card for the pasted link. Not in the corpus.

leadingMentions.evidence: X hides the leading mentions of a reply; the reply-ness is server state, not a text shape. Captured post @levelsio/2119915360849727842 opens with '@TermiusHQ' and shows it, and its display_text_range starts at 0. Rules therefore hides only when Post::reply_to is set. The server marks a reply's body with display_text_range[0] > 0.
leadingMentions.unverifiedReason: Needs the behavior lab: reply with 1-3 leading mentions, with and without a .@ prefix, and read display_text_range.

attachmentPrecedence.evidence: Corpus: 270 payloads, no post carries both media and a card (0 of 78 card posts have media; 0 of 124 media posts have a card). X's composer cannot combine a poll with media. Quote+media is allowed by X but the model exposes one attachment slot; precedence order is documented in SPEC.md.
attachmentPrecedence.corpusNote: A card post's full_text ends with the card's t.co URL and display_text_range includes it; the client hides it via the card attachment range, not the server.

cardLink.evidence: Client hides the URL that matches card.legacy.url and stops scanning at the first trailing non-matching URL, so the card is bound to one URL. Which URL X's crawler picks is server-side; the corpus has only single-URL card posts (61/61).
cardLink.unverifiedReason: Needs the behavior lab: put the same card-worthy link at start, middle and end, and with two different card links.

cardDismissal.clearedWhen: the joined list of URLs in the draft text changes
cardDismissal.evidence: Client composer slice: B5hEoqI4.js y(): g=`tombstone://card`, _=(0,o.i)(`cardPreview`,{dismissed:!1}); f(): getSendPayload(e){return _.get(e).dismissed?{card_uri:g}:{}}; p(): subscribeSelector(d,...,reset when d changes); d(e) joins url entities with the jetfuelUrl.

cardTypes.rendersWhen: the link has metadata with a card type and no higher-priority attachment is present
cardTypes.evidence: Card name dispatch: DIdg36-I.js summary card parser (variant `image-overlay` only for summary_large_image with an image, else `thumbnail-detail`); CbDtO_Fz.js card_name from card.legacy.name; unified card parser keyed by name `unified_card`. Corpus card names: summary_large_image 65, summary 4, 745291183405076480:broadcast 2 (logged-out public posts; no ad or player cards captured).

replyContext.evidence: Post-detail markup (probe.html, post-vercel.html) shows the main text without a clamp; full long text lives in note_tweet.
replyContext.unverifiedReason: Thread and reply ordering are outside this ruleset; the frame renders one post.

relativeTime.hours: Nh below 86400s, with ' Nm' appended unless minutes are 0 or precision is Hours
relativeTime.days: same calendar year: 'MMM d' (e.g. Nov 5); otherwise 'MMM d, yyyy'
relativeTime.evidence: CbDtO_Fz.js s({timestamp,lang,timeZone,nowLabel,precision}): p<60 m(h,p); p<3600 m(g,floor(p/60)); p<86400 hours with `${e} ${m(g,t)}` unless precision===`Hours`||t===0; else Intl month short/day, adding year only when the year differs.

actionRow.algorithm: compact; maximumFractionDigits = 1 unless that rendering is at least 5 characters long, then 0
actionRow.evidence: B8JKwKas.js sha256 95b6e2a00ef2968b... engagement-button-Oyb-Yev6: a(e,t){ ... new Intl.NumberFormat(t,f).format(e).length>=5?0:1 }, f={maximumFractionDigits:1,notation:`compact`,roundingMode:`trunc`}, and the pill renders AnimatedCount with format:{...f,maximumFractionDigits:a(count,language)}. 464 aria-label/rendered pairs in the captured markup confirm it (frame/numbers.rs test table): 1938->1.9K, 1000->1K, 12490->12K, 987654->987K, 4082915->4M, 37047269->37M.

views.algorithm: plain grouped below 10000; compact with maximumFractionDigits 1 and trunc rounding above
views.evidence: 29V4YPN-.js sha256 10b603cd9f5fe610... view-count-utils-Zx47M6cA: s=1e4, c={maximumFractionDigits:1,notation:`compact`,roundingMode:`trunc`}; o(e,n) returns {compactCount:e<s?plain:compact, fullCount}. Used by the detail Views label and profile stats (CsKZbcGK.js call sites).

memberCount.algorithm: compact with maximumFractionDigits 1 and trunc rounding at every magnitude
memberCount.evidence: CU05W8xc.js sha256 f614b067b07f49d3... format-member-count-qG_2NhH0: new Intl.NumberFormat(t,{maximumFractionDigits:1,notation:`compact`,roundingMode:`trunc`}). Community member counts.

pollVotes.evidence: BuK4PrYn.js sha256 d5c933aae139c31c... poll card: new Intl.NumberFormat(a.language) then `{formattedCount} {count, plural, one {vote} other {votes}}`. Poll totals are not abbreviated.

entityLabels.evidence: Captured post elonmusk/2119617455102333206: full_text says 'Grok @Bot', mention_entities[{indices:[44,48],screen_name:'bot'}], and the page prints 'Grok @bot'. Rules prints the server label when the input carries one, otherwise the token as written.

eligibility.outerCrowded: reject when outer.reply_to is set (promoted, mid-conversation and birdwatch state are not in Post)
eligibility.missingNestedAuthor: reject when q2 has no author handle
eligibility.selfQuote: reject when outer.author and q1.author match or q1.author and q2.author match (handles compared case-insensitively, @ trimmed)
eligibility.nestedCardOrPoll: reject when q2 has any link with card metadata, or a poll
eligibility.mediaBudget: (outer renders media, q1 renders media/card/poll, q2 has media) may have at most one true

nestedQuotePreview.entityRendering: render-entity-as-text: mention @screen_name, hashtag #text, cashtag $text, timestamp its text, URL displayUrl; the span uses color/size/weight inherit, so entities are plain primary text, not brand links
nestedQuotePreview.evidence: 55591fe0 chunk dfWSwB9n.js (sha256 d44215ba04fa6bfd…) module nested-quote-preview-SIs_tkfq: functions H(e,t,n), ae(e), I/L/z(q2/q1 media predicates) and ie(q2 card/poll/sensitive veto); clamp ke=2 and renderEntity render-entity-as-text in component ve; entity module B0X1tFzr.js (sha256 e48f50b239fa2cb0…) maps mention/hashtag/cashtag/timestamp to display text, URL to displayUrl, and wraps the span with color:inherit, size:inherit, weight:inherit. The same H, with the same fragment hash eb326beec0968fb72285af4ec33cf74d, is in 89824c04 DIdg36-I.js (8ee525ba…) and 1037d89b BsiDb726.js (e46395f6…): identical code across the three pinned versions. Corpus: all five nested-quote posts are rejected and none of their pages carries the preview markup (w-[3px] rule, rounded-[9px], sr-only Quote): elonmusk 2119812607117062451 (q1 photo + q2 video = two media), NBA 2120015774983008464 and binance 2119655363385659500 (self-quote q1==q2), karpathy 2109361546505966046 (outer==q1), levelsio 2116843791214629021 (outer==q1). The compact payloads do not carry q2's media/text (the client fetches q2 with getNestedQuotePreviewTweet_quoted), so elonmusk's q2 video is only in the lead's evidence, not in our payload copy.
nestedQuotePreview.unverifiedReason: Promoted/mid-conversation/birdwatch crowding, sensitive-media flags and article/jetfuel attachments are not modeled in Post; only reply_to, card, poll and media are checked. X fetches q2 separately, so a captured profile payload cannot exercise a positive preview.

embeddedMedia.hidesPermalinks: x.com|twitter.com (www.|mobile.|m.)/<handle|i>/status/<digits>/(video|photo)/<1..4>, any query (?t=…, ?s=20) or trailing slash
embeddedMedia.requires: Post::media is non-empty (the attachment is Media)
embeddedMedia.strips: a mid-text URL takes one preceding space with it (text[n-1] === ' ' ? n-1 : n); a trailing range trims all preceding whitespace (hiddenRanges.trailingWhitespace)
embeddedMedia.leaves: external links (bit.ly, vercel.com, polygon.com, …), non-media twimg URLs (profile_images, card_img) and /status/<id> links without /video|photo/<n> stay visible
embeddedMedia.evidence: tU-nr9vs.js sha256 55cb51684c9fe415… module quote-media-toggle-jMLU_r6g function n(e,t): let[n,i]=t,a=e.text[n-1]===' '?n-1:n; r.updateText(e.text.slice(0,a)+e.text.slice(i)). BNn3ozGQ.js sha256 60ad8cfa33fd2665… modules post-media-menu-item-jECN8x_w and get-embeddable-media-url-X8kC4tDT: builds /<handle|i>/status/<id>/(video|photo)/<N> from source_status_id_str and expanded_url's /(?:photo|video)/(\d+)(?:[/?#]|$)/, resolved against https://x.com with the original search and hash; direct media URLs come from media_url_https (video.twimg.com, pbs.twimg.com). Corpus: ESPN.html 2120005259485425936 is a video post whose full_text ends with the server-appended media t.co, hidden by display_text_range; no captured post shows an x.com/twitter.com media permalink or twimg media URL in its text (0 of 288), so external-link parity is untouched.
embeddedMedia.unverifiedReason: A post that already has media and deliberately links another post's media rather than embedding it: the composer embeds on paste, so captured payloads cannot show that state.
